description: List the companies this connection can work in, each with its `company` value, tenant and device counts (total, by status, and ACTIVE devices with no check-in for 7 days or more), plus totals across every listed company. Use it to answer questions about the whole fleet across companies, or to find a company, then pass its `company` value as the company argument of any other tool to work in it. A connection made for one company (or an API key) lists only that company.

page.description: Zero-based page of the list, sorted by device count (most devices first). Default 0.

query.description: Optional. Only companies whose name, company value or tenant contains this text (case-insensitive).

name: list_companies
title: List companies
